ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

carbon.$description: Carbon — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary dark surface, button hover states

slate.$description: Slate — Body text, secondary headings, dense paragraph copy

steel.$description: Steel — Muted helper text, tertiary metadata, subdued links

silver.$description: Silver — Disabled states, placeholder text, low-priority captions

bone.$description: Bone — Hairline borders, divider lines, card outlines, structural separators

cloud.$description: Cloud — Subtle background wash, hover state for neutral surfaces

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills

cobalt-signal.$description: Cobalt Signal — Promotional announcement bar, brand accent — the only chromatic moment in the system, used sparingly to signal news or offers without competing with the research content

abcnormal.$description: Sole typeface across the entire interface — navigation, body, buttons, and display headlines. Weight 450 (a half-step) and 500 carry most UI text; 600 is reserved for emphasis. The tight tracking on large sizes (-0.025em at 48px) prevents headlines from feeling airy, keeping them grounded as editorial statements rather than marketing shouts. The positive tracking at 11px (+0.025em) compensates for small-size readability. Weight 400 for body keeps long research paragraphs light on the eye.
